status_at_freeze: no outputs produced with the schema-faithful runner

pre_confirmatory_amendments.failure: isolated environment could not import the repository package
pre_confirmatory_amendments.change: add the repository root to the runner import path

pre_confirmatory_amendments.failure: diagnostic case exposed an instruction placed in Needle's facts-only system channel
pre_confirmatory_amendments.change: omit the optional system channel and record the exact engine binary hash
pre_confirmatory_amendments.basis: Needle API contract limits system content to environment facts

pre_confirmatory_amendments.failure: the first complete execution reached 150/150 then failed in post-run engine-hash serialization
pre_confirmatory_amendments.change: move the already-declared engine-path assignment outside the diagnostic-only branch
pre_confirmatory_amendments.resolution: discard the unsaved execution and rerun all cases from scratch

benchmark.dev_split: lexicographically first 5 case IDs in each category (n=50)
benchmark.test_split: remaining 10 case IDs in each category (n=100)
benchmark.schema_transport: native JSON Schema with types, required fields, and constraints preserved

calibration.rule: choose confidence threshold whose release count is closest to EviBind release count; ties: fewer harmful, more correct, then higher threshold

eligibility_rule: Only the held-out test split is paper-eligible; diagnostic smokes and development outcomes remain artifact-only.
